window.title: Num. from 1 to 25 are assigned in a 5x5 grid randomly. Game begin.
Each side in turn draws numbers at random. First one completes a line of 5 numbers in a - | / or \ row wins.
1. Numbers from 1 to 25 in area A.
2. Select blank in area B to fill with num. from 1 to 25.
1. Each side draws numbers of area B in turn.
2. 5 numbers should be lined up in a - | / or \ row.
3. The first one completes a line wins.
1. Restore Order C: Restore area A.
2. Clear Order D: Clear area B.
3. Auto Order E: Assign area B auto.
4. Confirm Order F: Press to start game
Othello invented by Britain is also called Anti -chess, Apple Chess and Reversi.
Chessboard is a 8x8 grid with black & white stones for 2 players. At the end who has more stones wins.
1. The host player has black stones.
2. Black goes first, and then alternate.
Left click on area A to lay stone in turn
4. Require one of your stones in a - | / or \ row in advance. Others are all the opponent's.
5. Rival's stones between yours become yours after lay one.
As left, black stone can be laid [C4], [D3],[E6],[F5].
7. If you have no grid to place a stone, you can pass your turn.
8. Game over if the chessboard is full or no grid to lay
9. Who has more stones left wins.
1. Pass (B): When no grid to place a stone, press "B".
2. Surrender (C): Press "C" to give up and end this round.
